title: CION Investment Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: CION Investment Corporation filed a Form 8-K on April 21, 2026 disclosing that Aron I. Schwartz, a Class II independent director, will not stand for re-election at the June 25, 2026 Annual Meeting due to other professional opportunities. The Board subsequently approved reducing its size from eight to seven members, effective at the Annual Meeting. The departure is not related to any disagreement with the Company.
key_points: Director Aron I. Schwartz (Class II independent director) will not stand for re-election at the 2026 Annual Meeting scheduled for June 25, 2026
Reason given: other professional opportunities; no disagreement with Company
Board approved decrease in board size from 8 to 7 members effective at Annual Meeting
Schwartz will continue serving on Audit, Nominating and Corporate Governance, and Compensation Committees until Annual Meeting
Company is a business development company (BDC) registered on NYSE under symbols CION, CICB, CICC
